name: Warm Like Flesh
summary:
Warm Like Flesh is a short 2D rpg game with visual novel and point-and-click elements.

You are a technician tasked with maintaining a sentient, humanoid computer named "CATHODE" who has the tendency to murmur cryptic and flirtatious lines. Your job? Keep Cathode "alive" by reconnecting their frayed neural pathways (wires) while navigating their unsettlingly intimate commentary.
